title: Old Bay Fried Shrimp
description: Old Bay fried shrimp are first soaked in milk and eggs before being coated in an Old Bay and cornmeal blend. This recipe is sure to be a new favorite.
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
3 large eggs, or more as needed
2 cups milk, or more as needed
0.5 cup seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)

steps.text: Place shrimp on a flat work surface. Slice horizontally through middle of each shrimp, being careful not to cut all the way through to the other side.
Whisk eggs in a large bowl; whisk in milk. Place shrimp in egg-milk mixture; soak 1 hour.
Heat oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Whisk flour, cornmeal, and seafood seasoning together; transfer to a resealable plastic bag. Place 5 to 6 shrimp in the bag; shake well until coated. Place coated shrimp, unstacked, onto a plate. Repeat with remaining shrimp.
Lower shrimp carefully into the hot oil in batches. Fry until golden brown and opaque in centers, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain. Repeat with remaining shrimp.
